title: Basic katakana: R and W rows and ン — find the sign
description: Choose the written sign from three visible kana using a basic sound or specified spelling context. 8 independent targets.

review.provenance: Independent agent-authored katakana sign cues and feedback; no CSV or mock text reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-authored English copy and glosses; katakana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party text or audio used.

exercises.prompt: Which katakana sign has the basic reading conventionally written ra in Latin letters?

text.gloss: Katakana sign for the basic ra reading.
Katakana sign for the basic ri reading.
Katakana sign for the basic ru reading.

exercises.explanation: ラ is the katakana sign for the written ra cue. Katakana sign for the basic ra reading. Different written forms are not interchangeable by sound alone.
